summary: @or-sdk/notifications 1.7.6 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall script `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs uses hex-named identifiers, probes the host platform, downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, sets it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against the bundled math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line file using string-array rotation (function WV8StW shifting a ~500-entry const table n7gIxM) with randomized hex identifiers and fragmented encoded string constants. Running the bundled payload through a freshly-downloaded second language runtime executes install-time code outside the Node process any Node-based install-time inspector would observe. The scope `@or-sdk` also appears in an internal GitLab registry referenced by CHANGELOG.md (gitlab.internal.onereach.io/onereach/platform/or-sdk-next), while this tarball is published to public npm — the shape is consistent with dependency-confusion targeting installers who expect the private-scoped package. Installing this version runs the obfuscated payload on the installer's machine at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
